messages:
Alex: Midweek deploy bulletin — quick update on the staggered rollout schedule and one urgent exception. Please read + react. :megaphone:
Priya: TL;DR? what needs immediate attention? :eyes:
Alex: Short: rolling deploy to eu-west and us-west tonight starting 22:00 UTC, 10% -> 30% -> 100% over 3h windows. We have a hotfix candidate for an embeddings quantization perf regression that landed this morning; request freeze-exemption to push it mid-canary.
Mateo: Can we hold canary at 0% while we validate the hotfix? metrics show ~5% token latency increase on long sequences for a small subset.
Jordan: Product approves expedited patch if SLOs are impacted. Need release notes updated and a customer heads-up for accounts on Dedicated tier.
Alex: Ok — plan: start canary at 0% to baseline for 30m, apply hotfix to canary shard, run synthetic throughputs for 20m, then escalate percentages if green. If not green, rollback and open incident.
deploy-bot: deploy request received: repo=runtime, branch=hotfix/emb-quant-fix, target=canary, rollout=manual, initiated_by=@Alex
Priya: Marcus, can you take oncall watch for the 22:00 window? I'll own metrics and traces.
Marcus: Oncall assigned. I'll be at my laptop from 21:45–00:30 UTC, ping me in #eng-oncall if anything spikes.
Mateo: PR is queued. Command I'll run once approved:
```
./bin/deploy --env=canary --image=runtime:hotfix-emb-2026-03-23 --max-parallel=2
```
Lena: I'll update the release notes draft and add a short blurb about the perf regression + fix. CC @CustomerSuccess for proactive outreach.
SRE-bot: Canary cluster health check started. baseline CPU/mem/latency collection enabled.
Alex: Freeze-exemption request: urgent-security=no, customer-impact=potential perf regression for long sequences, risk=low-medium. Approve? react :thumbsup: to approve, :thumbsdown: to deny.
Jordan: :thumbsup: from product.
Priya: :thumbsup: from SRE (will monitor).
Marcus: :thumbsup: oncall here.
Alex: Approved. Mateo, proceed when ready. Keep canary at 0% until SRE-bot signals green.
Mateo: Pushing now, small window for rollout. Will post logs here.
deploy-bot: deploy started: runtime/canary -> image runtime:hotfix-emb-2026-03-23. build=6421.
Mateo: Smoke logs: no OOMs, KV cache warmup normal, 95p latency back to baseline after patch.
SRE-bot: Canary health: PASS. anomaly_score=0.03, error_rate=0.001.
Priya: Running 20m synthetic run, will share graphs in 10m.
Alex: If synthetic passes, we go to 10% for 30m then standard ramp. If anything regresses we rollback.
Priya: Synthetic run complete — metrics look good. 95p latency within 1% of pre-issue baseline.
Mateo: Bumping canary to 10% now.
deploy-bot: rollout update: canary -> 10% after manual approval.
Marcus: No alert noise from infra. Logs look clean.
Lena: Release notes updated: added section "Embeddings: quantization regression fixed — improves long-sequence latency". Will ping CS.
Jordan: Notifying top-tier customers with Dedicated shipments — template message posted to #customer-comms.
Alex: Final checklist: 1) Monitor metrics for next 3h (Priya + Marcus), 2) CS outreach (Lena), 3) Postmortem? only if rollback/incident.
Priya: I'll keep a 15m cadence for the next 3h and post snapshots here.
Mateo: Leaving a short diff link: https://git.internal/runtime/compare/hotfix-emb-2026 -> please thumbs up if looks correct.
Alex: Thanks all. Summary: freeze-exemption granted, hotfix deployed to canary, canary->10% now, plan to finish roll by 01:00 UTC if steady. Any blockers speak up now. :rocket:
